brief: Read from a stream to base64Binary
description: Read a stream up to a specified number of octets. The result will be the internal memory of a base64Binary value. n must be a non-negative integer and must not exceed 1,000,000.

errorsThrown.reason: n is negative or exceeds the maximum allowed

parameters.description: The maximum number of octets to read (0 or more, up to 1,000,000).
parameters.name: n

returns.description: The base64Binary value read. Check the size of this value to determine the actual number of octets read.
